Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding more than 0.8% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising almost 0.7 %.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) SAP SE ( SAP ) was fractionally lower on Tuesday, paring a 2.5% decline earlier in today's session that followed the software and applications saying it will introduce five new machine learning services over the rest of 2018. They are: scene text recognition, customizable image segmentation, customizable text feature extraction, cloud text-to-speech by Google, and cloud speech-to-text by Google.
In other sector news:
(+) Cadence Design Systems ( CDNS ) advanced almost 14% on Tuesday after the automated software design company reported non-GAAP Q3 net income of $0.49 per share, improving on a $0.35 per share gain during the year-ago period and beating the Street view by $0.08 per share.
(-) Logitech International SA ( LOGI ) slid nearly 12% on Tuesday after posting fiscal Q2 revenue shy of analyst forecasts and better-than-expected non-GAAP net income earnings that were better-than-expected on improved revenues which were shy of forecasts compiled by Capital IQ.
